@CC ====================================================================
@CC CHATBOOT:MODE - the chat block for the END of a machine's boot mode
@CC file, (PACK-ONE:UTILITY)XMSG-STARTEX-L03:MODE on the lab machines.
@CC
@CC Paste these lines AFTER XMSG and COSMOS are up in that file. Change
@CC FJELL to what this machine is called and the two numbers to the
@CC system numbers it trunks to. One trunk end is enough, both is fine.
@CC
@CC A plain @RT is enough on a cold boot: the RT description and its
@CC segment survive a reboot. The name and the trunks do NOT - the server
@CC keeps neither on disk - so they are typed again here.
@CC
@CC BEFORE PUTTING THIS IN A BOOT FILE, run it once by hand as
@CC   @MODE CHATBOOT:MODE,,
@CC If "CHATBOOT REACHED THE END" prints, MODE input reached CHAT-MON and
@CC the terminal came back. If it does not, CHAT-MON is waiting on the
@CC terminal for input that never comes, and inside a boot file that is a
@CC machine you cannot log in to.
@CC ====================================================================
@RT CHATSER
@CHAT-MON
SET-NAME FJELL
START-TRUNK 102
START-TRUNK 103
LIST-TRUNKS
EXIT
@CC CHATBOOT REACHED THE END
